statement: CoreWeave lists an on-demand rate of $49.24 per hour for an eight-GPU NVIDIA HGX H100 node in both North America and Europe, with no prior-period baseline shown.
why: Listed rental rates are the visible reference price for renting accelerators, but a single capture without a baseline says nothing about direction.

impact.mechanism: Published rental rates set the reference cost of accelerator capacity for renters; as a static level with no baseline it is a display overlay only.

evidence.excerpt: these are per-8-GPU-node (HGX) or per-4-GPU-node (GB200 NVL72) prices, not per-single-GPU prices

confidence.basis: Vendor pricing page captured once; secondary source with no baseline or history, and the unit is per node rather than per GPU.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: statement/trend changed (trend unknown -> unknown); sources: CoreWeave
